As the year draws to a close, I am pleased to share a few updates from *Bayesian Analysis*.

### BA at Major International Meetings in 2026

I am delighted to announce the *Bayesian Analysis Highlights* session at the [2026 ISBA World Meeting](https://isba2026.github.io/) in Nagoya (June 28--July 3, 2026). This session will showcase three highlights among the recently accepted papers in the journal:

- [Sudipto Banerjee](http://sudipto.bol.ucla.edu/) (University of California, Los Angeles)  
  *Bayesian inference for spatial-temporal non-Gaussian data using predictive stacking*  
  Joint work with S. Pan, L. Zhang, and J.\,R. Bradley

- [Sarah Filippi](https://profiles.imperial.ac.uk/s.filippi) (Imperial College London)  
  *Group Spike-and-Slab Variational Bayes*  
  Joint work with M. Komodromos, M. Evangelou, and K. Ray

- [Subhashis Ghosal](https://www4.stat.ncsu.edu/~sghosal/) (North Carolina State University)  
  *Bayesian Semi-supervised Multi-category Classification under Nonparanormality*  
  Joint work with R. Zhu and S. Ghosh

*Bayesian Analysis* will also be featured at the  
[Joint Statistical Meetings 2026](https://ww2.amstat.org/meetings/jsm/2026/) in Boston (August 1--6, 2026). I am particularly pleased to report that our attempt to resume the tradition of having a *Bayesian Analysis* session at JSM, interrupted during the pandemic, has been successful: the proposal was accepted as an invited session, with an outstanding lineup:

- [Amy Herring](https://globalhealth.duke.edu/people/herring-amy) (Duke University)  
  *Bayesian Modeling of Nearly Mutually Orthogonal Processes*  
  Joint work with J. Matuk and D.\,B. Dunson

- [Peter Müller](https://math.utexas.edu/directory/peter-mueller) (University of Texas at Austin)  
  *DPGLM: A Semiparametric Bayesian GLM with Inhomogeneous Normalized Random Measures*  
  Joint work with E. Alam and P.\,J. Rathouz

- [Debdeep Pati](https://pages.stat.wisc.edu/~dpati2/) (University of Wisconsin)  
  *Robust Probabilistic Inference via a Constrained Transport Metric*  
  Joint work with A. Chakraborty and A. Bhattacharya

- [Marina Vannucci](https://marina.blogs.rice.edu/) (Rice University)  
  *A Bayesian Approach for Inference on Mixed Graphical Models*  
  Joint work with M. Florez, A. Gottard, C. McAdams, and M. Guindani

These sessions showcase the breadth of topics and the strength of recent work appearing in *Bayesian Analysis*. I thank all speakers for their contributions and warmly encourage you to attend these sessions.

### Lindley Prize

I would also like to provide a brief update concerning the Lindley Prize. The [December 2025 issue](https://projecteuclid.org/journals/bayesian-analysis/volume-20/issue-4) includes a dedicated section with the seven papers in contention. These contributions were presented at the 2024 ISBA World Meeting in Venice and subsequently accepted for publication in *Bayesian Analysis*. Choosing a winner among them will not be easy, and I am very grateful to the Lindley Prize Committee for their careful and thoughtful work. The winner will be announced during the World Meeting in Nagoya.

As we approach the end of the year, I would like to wish all readers happy holidays and a happy New Year. If you find a quiet moment over the holiday break, I encourage you to take a look at the many excellent papers recently accepted and now available in the [Advance Publication section](https://projecteuclid.org/journals/bayesian-analysis/advance-publication) of the journal.
